risks.title: Cert collecting
risks.fix: If you're cramming exam dumps, stop. An exam only counts if the phase's project exists.

risks.title: Burnout
risks.fix: Drop to maintenance mode (Anki plus one weekend block) instead of quitting. The plan can stretch to 48 months.

risks.title: Vendor churn
risks.fix: Exams get retired and renamed. Check each exam page when you book.

risks.title: Breadth without depth
risks.fix: In every phase, pick one area to go deep on, and become the person people ask.

rules: Run at most two tracks at once: one deep phase and the coding track.
Never prepare for two exams at the same time.
If a project teaches more than the syllabus, put the project first and move the exam.
Keep one public repo with notes, labs and projects for each phase.
Use Anki for facts you must recall cold: ports, syscalls, kubectl flags, IAM logic.
Buy Linux Foundation exams in sales. Each AWS pass gives a 50% voucher for the next.
